snippet.title: A.A.U. Reveal Trailer #1
snippet.description:
This is the official first reveal trailer for A.A.U. Black Site, introducing the world, tone, and intensity of the upcoming action‑horror FPS. Step into the abandoned territory of Uzovnica and witness the beginning of a mission that collapses the moment it starts.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607440/AAU/

Visit our website:
https://raspberrygamestudio.com/

As an operative of the covert special forces unit A.A.U., you were deployed to Serbia on a classified assignment. But the moment you carried out your orders, everything changed.
Framed. Intercepted. Cut off from extraction.
Now you’re trapped inside Uzovnica — alone, hunted, and surrounded by a reality that refuses to behave as it should.

Join the community:
Discord — https://discord.com/invite/7ZGHP7qyny

Follow A.A.U. Black Site for official updates:
X — https://x.com/AAUBlackSite  
Instagram — https://www.instagram.com/aaublacksite/  
TikTok — https://www.tiktok.com/@aaublacksite  
Facebook — https://www.facebook.com/AAUBlackSite/  
Reddit — https://www.reddit.com/r/AAUBlackSite/

Developed by Raspberry Studio.
